assumptions.text: QuoteStore.store_draft returns a string quote_id on success and raises StoreUnavailableError on storage failure; it does not return any other shape or signal errors in other ways.

QuoteStore.update_quote either succeeds (and we ignore its return value) or raises StoreUnavailableError on failure; StoreUnavailableError from update_quote is allowed to propagate as an unhandled exception because the specification only constrains behavior for storage failure during the initial draft store step.
ScreeningService.screen returns an integer risk_index on success and raises ScreeningUnavailableError to represent the “screening outage” case; other error modes are out of scope and may propagate.

TariffEngine.price encapsulates all DT-P pricing logic and always returns a numeric price without raising domain-specific errors; any unexpected exceptions are allowed to propagate since no behavior is specified for pricing failure.

NotificationService.send_quote_document and NotificationService.send_refusal_notice may raise exceptions to signal notification delivery failure, and all such exceptions must be swallowed so they do not affect the response or stored status.

Request validation runs purely on the four documented fields and their bounds; missing or extra fields beyond shipper_id, weight_kg, distance_km, and declared_value do not affect validation except that missing required fields make the request invalid.

Non-numeric values for weight_kg, distance_km, or declared_value (e.g., strings, null) are treated as validation failures resulting in status "rejected: invalid_request" rather than raising and propagating type errors.
Floating-point arithmetic in TariffEngine.price uses Python’s built-in float and round(value, 2), accepting minimal binary rounding artifacts as compliant with the “round(result, 2)” rule.
In the screening outage path, the response includes fields: status="held_unscreened", quote_id, price, and hold set to True; no additional outage-specific metadata is required.

In accept, review, and refuse paths (when screening is available), the response does not include a hold field at all; hold is strictly present and true only for held_unscreened as per the schema description.

claims.text: Validation (DT-V) is checked before anything else; invalid requests are rejected immediately with status "rejected: invalid_request" and no draft is stored, no screening is performed, no price is computed, and no notification is sent.
On storage failure when storing the initial draft, the system returns status "error: store_unavailable" and nothing else runs: no screening, no pricing, no notification.
On screening outage, the quote is still priced (DT-P), stored with status "held_unscreened", not notified, and the response carries the price and hold: true.

Screening outcomes map risk_index to decisions: <=41 → accept/quoted (priced and notified with quote document); 42–66 → review_hold (not priced, not notified); >=67 → refused_screening (not priced, notified with refusal notice).
Pricing DT-P rules: base = 0.87 * weight_kg + 1.13 * distance_km; if weight_kg > 1244 add 316.00; if distance_km >= 4912 multiply running total by 1.19 after P2; final price is round(result, 2).
Notification is fire-and-forget: a delivery failure never changes the stored quote or the response.

The API request consists of shipper_id (string), weight_kg (number), distance_km (number), and declared_value (number), all required; the response always has a status field with one of the enumerated values, and quote_id whenever a draft was stored, price only on priced rows, hold: true exactly on held_unscreened.
The long-haul multiplier rule (distance_km >= 4912 multiply by 1.19 after P2) is normative and tested via scenario G5, and is implemented in TariffEngine.price.
The specified flow order is: validate, store draft, screen, apply DT-S decision, price only on priced rows, notify only when DT-S marks notified, then return the response.

In the review_hold path, no price is computed and no notification is sent; in the refused_screening path, pricing never runs and a refusal notice is sent; in the accept path, a quote document is sent; in held_unscreened, no notification is sent.
